context.si_title: Solution Intent - Synthetic Order Routing Service

outcome_evidence.quote: The review outcome is changes requested until the findings and missing evidence are resolved.
outcome_evidence.speaker: Morgan Lee

findings.title: Retry controls are undefined
findings.description: The design does not define the retry budget, backoff limits, or automatic-processing stop condition for ambiguous provider responses.
findings.recommended_change: Document a bounded retry budget, exponential-backoff limits, and the stop condition before another provider submission.

evidence.quote: The current design does not define the retry budget, exponential-backoff limits, or the point at which an unknown response must stop automatic processing.
The retry budget and exponential-backoff limits are not defined, so that is a high-severity finding.
evidence.speaker: Morgan Lee

findings.title: Regional failover evidence is missing
findings.description: The warm standby design has neither a scheduled exercise nor a measured recovery result.
findings.recommended_change: Schedule the regional exercise and record measured recovery results against the draft targets.

evidence.quote: Regional recovery uses a warm standby design, but no failover exercise has been scheduled and no measured recovery result exists.
The warm standby design has no scheduled regional failover exercise or measured recovery result.
evidence.speaker: Morgan Lee

findings.title: Routing-record retention lacks approval
findings.description: The proposed 30-day routing-record retention period has not received formal governance confirmation.
findings.recommended_change: Obtain and record governance approval for the retention period before release readiness.

evidence.quote: The proposed 30-day routing-record retention period requires governance confirmation before the design can be treated as release ready.
Formal approval of the 30-day routing-record retention period is missing, so the privacy control remains open.
evidence.speaker: Morgan Lee

decisions.statement: Use an event-driven asynchronous routing model with provider-specific adapters.
decisions.rationale: The boundary keeps the storefront independent from provider response formats and timing.

evidence.quote: I confirm the event-driven asynchronous routing model with provider-specific adapters as the architecture decision for this review.
evidence.speaker: Morgan Lee

risks.description: An ambiguous provider timeout followed by an unsafe retry could create duplicate fulfilment.

evidence.quote: Without those controls, repeated submission after an ambiguous provider response could create duplicate fulfilment.
An ambiguous provider timeout followed by an unsafe retry could create duplicate fulfilment, which is a high risk.
evidence.speaker: Morgan Lee

evidence.quote: I will document the retry budget, backoff limits, and stop condition by 18 September 2026.
evidence.speaker: Riley Chen

action_items.title: Schedule and document the regional failover exercise

evidence.quote: I will schedule and document the regional failover exercise by 21 September 2026.
evidence.speaker: Avery Patel

open_questions.question: What is the maximum duration for a manual routing override?

evidence.quote: The maximum duration for a manual routing override remains an open question because a long override could bypass current capacity signals.
We need to decide the maximum duration for a manual routing override before release readiness.
evidence.speaker: Avery Patel

missing_evidence.item: Approved alert thresholds and response target
missing_evidence.reason: Operational readiness cannot be assessed without numeric thresholds and an evidence-backed response target.

evidence.quote: Approved numeric alert thresholds and an evidence-backed on-call response target are not yet available.
Approved numeric alert thresholds and an evidence-backed on-call response target are not available yet.
evidence.speaker: Riley Chen

missing_evidence.reason: A named escalation roster and approved after-hours handoff are required for release readiness.

evidence.quote: A named production support escalation roster and approved after-hours handoff are missing.
The runbook does not identify the production support escalation roster or approved after-hours handoff.
evidence.speaker: Casey Wong
